phase: Phase 3 of 5: parallel builders finishing, merging + verifying into the integration branch
summary: Plan: (1) baseline measured, (2) shared disaster foundation built, (3) 7 builder agents in isolated worktrees, (4) independent critics + verification agents, (5) final baseline comparison, changelog, PR. Nothing counts as done until it is merged, tested and measured in the actual game.

workstreams.name: Baseline + performance instrumentation
workstreams.detail: PerfMonitor (frame/JS/GPU ms, draw calls, heap, long tasks, entities, network) + scripts/bench.mjs; baseline JSON recorded before changes.

workstreams.name: Disaster foundation (manager, journal/restore, debris, effects, reactions, permissions, save)
workstreams.detail: Deterministic command-driven manager, per-tick edit budgets, full journaled restore, instanced pooled debris, NPC/animal evacuate/swim/airborne reactions, admin permission model, save isolation.

workstreams.name: Fix: bookshelves visible on the back of buildings
workstreams.detail: Shelves moved inside against intact walls (shops, saloon, general store, hotel); verified by screenshot from the alley.

workstreams.name: Admin / debug control panel
workstreams.detail: Schema-driven DOM panel: selector, params, seed, preview/start (with warnings + confirm)/pause/stop/reset/replay, live intensity, save commit; 21/21 automated checks pass on the integration branch.

workstreams.name: NPC + animal eyes and blinking
workstreams.detail: Independent critic round 2: ACCEPT WITH NITS (all 10 criteria pass: two separated eyes, alignment, proportions, matching irises, natural unsynchronized blinking with exact restore, horse/cow/pig/chicken eyes, grid discipline). The three remaining nits (black-coat horse eye, cow side wrap, dark-skin brows) are applied and verified.

workstreams.name: Multiplayer (server-authoritative, synchronized disasters)
workstreams.detail: ws relay/authority, admin token, block relay, remote avatars, late-join replay; 8/8 sync checks pass on the integration branch (idle traffic ~1.45 KB/s per client).

workstreams.name: Tsunami & flood
workstreams.detail: Wave front, journaled rising water, crest destruction with buoyant debris, drain; 12/12 lifecycle checks pass on the integration branch; replay hash 415f9ebc:70177 reproduced. Perf re-measurement pending once the VM is quiet.

workstreams.name: Tornado
workstreams.detail: Deterministic wobbling track, Rankine wind field on debris/player/NPCs/animals, fragility-weighted ripping with orbiting debris, shader funnel + cloud deck + dust, storm lighting, church bell alarm, rope-out, path preview; 12/12 lifecycle checks pass; replay hash reproduced (f51c1ca6:334).

workstreams.name: Orbital beam
workstreams.detail: Builder committed the ring station, descending beam and deterministic crater carving; tuning crater floors and smoke.

workstreams.name: Chunk pipeline optimization
workstreams.detail: Bit-identical terrain/lighting (hash-verified) and 0 differing pixels; streaming JS roughly halved (walk window js avg 10-16 -> 5-10 ms, 500-640 ms stall frames gone), geometry memory -31.6%, load -25..-51%, 16-bit indices, exact AABB chunk culling. Cherry-picked into the integration branch; tsunami lifecycle still passes.

workstreams.name: Critics + verification (visuals, tests, replay, multiplayer, perf)
workstreams.detail: Eye critic done (round 1). Disaster visual critics, deterministic replay tests, multiplayer checks and perf comparison run after each merge.

log.text: Inspected project: single-player Three.js/Vite game, no multiplayer/save/permission code yet. Baseline measured with new PerfMonitor + bench script.
Disaster foundation committed (manager, journal, debris, effects, reactions API, permissions, save, tests). Bookshelf-backs bug fixed.
Spawned 7 builder agents in parallel (tsunami, tornado, beam, eyes, multiplayer, admin panel, optimization).
Admin panel merged: 21/21 checks pass on the integration branch.
Eyes merged + blinking wired into NPC renderer (1-2 unsynchronized blinks per NPC / 12 s verified).
Multiplayer merged: 8/8 synchronization checks pass on the integration branch.
Independent eye critic: narrow reject (brow/iris fusion, dark-coat horse eyes invisible). Fixes sent back to the eyes builder; animals no longer spawn on roofs; deputies got their own posts.
Tsunami merged: 12/12 lifecycle/replay/restore checks pass; engine relight coalescing + border-aware neighbour remesh added to cut flood frame cost.
Eyes round 2 merged into the integration branch; critic re-review started.
Optimization merged: identical visuals verified by pixel diff; streaming JS ~halved; -31% geometry memory; faster load.
Eye critic round 2: ACCEPT WITH NITS; nits applied (dark-coat horse eyes, cow wrap, dark-skin brows).
Tornado integrated: 12/12 checks pass. Draw-call analysis: ~225 of ~360 calls are NPC body parts (debris is one instanced draw) -> far-NPC LOD planned.

issues: Eyes: brow/iris contrast and dark-coat horse eyes being fixed (critic round 2 pending).
Multiplayer: NPCs/animals are client-side ambience (not synchronized); no server persistence; admin token in URL, no TLS.
Headless benchmark runs on software GL, so FPS/GPU figures are not representative of a real GPU; CPU-side metrics are compared.
